propositions: Changing a ticket's type silently replays a plan-review verdict computed under different type-dependent criteria, incorrectly treating the stored attestation as valid for the new type.

Both reuse paths (idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse) in reuse.py compare the material fingerprint and SHA but never check whether ticket_type has changed between the stored sidecar and current context.

A plan that passes review under type 'bug' (exempt from certain scoring gates) retains that PASS when retyped to 'task' (not exempt), incorrectly certifying a verdict never computed under task's criteria.
The stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already contains ticket_type but it is never read by the reuse decision logic, requiring no schema change to fix the validation.

The fix adds a type-change check in both reuse paths that fails open (returns None to force a full re-review) only when both stored and current type are truthy and differ, preserving backward compatibility with sidecars lacking a type value.
